name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 8:30 AM — timezone set to Asia/Taipei in Workflow Settings

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: { jobListings(filters: { remote: true }, first: 50) { edges { node { id title description url compensation { minValue maxValue currency } skills { displayName } company { name } } } } }

nodes.name: Fetch Wellfound
nodes.notes: Wellfound has no public API. Replace this node with a Wellfound scraper or manual RSS import if GraphQL fails.

nodes.name: Fetch YC Startup
nodes.notes: YC Work at a Startup requires scraping. Consider using Apify actor 'workatastartup-scraper' or similar.

nodes.name: Fetch Otta
nodes.notes: Otta has no public API. Replace with Apify scraper or skip if unavailable.

nodes.name: Get Existing URLs
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE with your actual Google Sheet ID

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
  "max_tokens": 300,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says 'remote.'
Reject if it requires living in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
Reject if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
Reject if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
Reject if it requires fixed hours that force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (midnight to 7am Taiwan time).

Keep only if:
- Worldwide remote / work from anywhere / global remote
- APAC remote
- International contractors accepted
- Accepts people based anywhere
- Hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown:
{
  "taiwan_eligible": "yes|no|unclear",
  "reason": "short reason under 20 words",
  "location_risk": "low|medium|high",
  "timezone_risk": "low|medium|high",
  "contractor_possible": "yes|no|unclear",
  "decision": "keep|reject|manual_check"
}

Job Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Location Text: {{ $json.location_text }}
Job Post:
{{ $json.description.substring(0, 2000) }}"
  }]
}

nodes.name: AI Taiwan Eligibility Check
nodes.notes: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in n8n Variables (Settings > Variables). Uses claude-haiku-4-5 for cost efficiency.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 600,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry applying to this role.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Jerry's background:
- Bilingual: English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background
- Data science bootcamp
- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience: dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Job: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Why it fits: {{ $json.why_good_fit }}
Job description excerpt:
{{ $json.description.substring(0, 1500) }}

Write a cover letter that:
- Is specific to this job
- Mentions how Jerry can reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, and turn messy data into business action
- Is under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- Do NOT use the phrase 'I am writing to apply'
- Start with a strong opening hook relevant to the role"
  }]
}

nodes.name: Telegram Instant Alert
nodes.notes: Set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in n8n Variables. Add your Telegram Bot credentials.

nodes.name: Send Gmail Digest
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_EMAIL@gmail.com with Jerry's email. Add Gmail OAuth2 credentials.
